title: Grilled Courgette Tostadas with Tomato Salsa
blurb: Charred courgette strips on crisp corn tortillas, topped with a fresh tomato and jalapeño salsa.
steps: Mix half the olive oil, chilli powder, half the garlic and half the lime juice in a large bowl, then toss the courgette slices in this mixture until well coated.
Heat a griddle or grill pan over high heat and cook the courgette slices for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until charred and tender.
Meanwhile, combine the tomatoes, jalapeño, red onion, remaining garlic, remaining lime juice, coriander and half the salt in a bowl to make the salsa.
Brush the tortillas lightly with the remaining olive oil and warm them on the griddle for about 30 seconds on each side until crisp.
Place each tortilla on a plate, top with grilled courgette slices and spoon over the fresh salsa.
Season with the remaining salt to taste and serve immediately.
